allocationStatus.title: Allocation Status
allocationStatus.description: Optional filter: e.g. Approved or Pending.

allocationType.title: Allocation Type
allocationType.description: Optional filter: Secured, Likely, or Pipeline.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country of the Budget Lines, e.g. Kenya. Reuse the country already resolved in the conversation.

dimensionName.title: Dimension Name
dimensionName.description: Optional: the dimension the value belongs to — Department, Cost Category, Cost Type, Sub-Unit, or Business Unit. Leave blank to auto-detect (asks if the value is ambiguous across dimensions).

dimensionValue.title: Dimension Value
dimensionValue.description: DIMENSION MODE: an explicit lower-level Budget Line value the user named that is NOT a standard program, e.g. Crop Insurance, Staff Costs. Reuse the dimension already resolved in the conversation. Combine with program to segment a standard program.

extraDimensionName.title: Extra Dimension Name
extraDimensionName.description: Optional dimension name for the second value (Department / Cost Category / Cost Type / Sub-Unit / Business Unit).

extraDimensionValue.title: Extra Dimension Value
extraDimensionValue.description: Optional second explicit dimension value, for combined filters.

fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year
fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year, e.g. 2027. Reuse the year already resolved in the conversation; defaults to the current scenario when omitted.

opportunityName.title: Opportunity Name
opportunityName.description: Optional: limit to one Opportunity by name.

program.title: Program
program.description: PROGRAM MODE: the standard Headroom category, e.g. Core Program, Trees. Reuse the category already resolved in the conversation. LEAVE BLANK for a pure dimension drill-down (e.g. allocations funding Crop Insurance).

showAll.title: Show All
showAll.description: Set true ONLY when the user explicitly asks for the full list ('show all', 'list every allocation') of a LARGE set (more than ~20). Returns every record up to a response-size safety cap. Not needed for small/medium sets — those are already returned in full.
